title: Psychedelic Ballet Dancers
description: Three blue-skinned ballerinas in pink and teal tutus perform a surreal, intertwined dance pose. They are covered in dripping colorful paint against a cosmic background of swirling purple, teal and orange nebulae, stars, lightning, and floating cannabis leaves.
prompt: Three blue-skinned ballerinas with flowing hair perform an intricate intertwined ballet pose, one lifted high while another lies on the swirling floor, all covered in dripping vibrant paint. They wear pink and teal tutus against a dark cosmic nebula background filled with stars, lightning bolts, orange and teal dripping liquid from above, and floating cannabis leaves, in a highly detailed surreal psychedelic style.
